description: This source file defines a ToastService class used for displaying toast notifications in a Blazor application. It manages showing toasts with different levels, starting countdown timers for auto-hiding, and handling cleanup. It also includes an enum ToastLevel for notification types.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: Service class implementing toast notification logic, including show, hide, countdown, and disposal functionalities.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specific level and starts the auto-hide countdown.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Resets and starts the timer that manages auto-hiding the toast.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Initializes the Timer object if not already created and sets its interval and event handler.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the timer elapses to hide the toast notification.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up Timer resources when the service is disposed.
